title: It's not possible to execute a rewards migration of a `BatonFarm`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it can lead to stuck rewards  **Likelihood:** Low, as it is not likely that a migration is needed  ## Description  The `BatonFarm` contract which is an external dependency of the `Nft` contract (a `BatonFarm` is deployed in `seedYieldFarm`) has a migration mechanism to move the unearned rewards to a new contract. This functionality is currently blocked, because it depends on a call from the `BatonFarm` owner (the `Nft` contract in this case) to the `initiateMigration` method of `BatonFarm`.
